newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy stock futures fall three pct at start.
newsitem.headline: Italy stock futures fall three pct at start.

text.p: The Italian September stock market futures contract fell 670 basis points at the start of trade on Monday and then a few minutes later was over 700 basis points down.
The contract fell to a morning low of 21,150, down 767 basis points or 3.5 percent, before recovering around 100 basis points.
By 0740 GMT the contract was 627 basis points lower at 21,290.
